simple.meaning: מַזְלֵג (mazlêg) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a fork.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 27:3. The surrounding context includes sacrifice, altar, priesthood, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַזְלֵג (H4207) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַזְלֵג (mazlêg) / H4207 is traced through Exodus 27:3, Exodus 38:3, Numbers 4:14, 1 Samuel 2:13 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;
and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.
and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
Huram his father also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for king Solomon, for Yahweh’s house, of bright bronze.

definitions.full: H4207. mazleg מַזְלֵג noun masculine apparently a sacrificial implement, three-pronged fork ׳הַמּ הַשִּׁנַּיִם שְׁלשׁ 1Sam 2:13 , compare 2:14 (see Dr Sm. pp. 23, 291 ). [ מִזְלָגָה ] noun [feminine] id., only plural הַמִּזְלָֹגת Exod 38:3 ; Num 4:14 ; הַמִּזְלָגוֺת 1Chr 28:17 ; 2Chr 4:16 ; suffix מִזְלְֹגתָיו Exod 27:3 ; — a sacrificial implement, belonging to altar in tabernacle, 27:3 ; 38:3 ; Num 4:14 (all P); belonging to temple 1Chr 28:17 ; 2Chr 4:16 .
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) מִזְלָגָה ; from an unused root meaning to draw up;
